card.episodesSentence: Counterfactual walk over the 673 sources that own a Carbon Mapper source (of the 1,122 sources MARS labels absent today — a label decided after the window), from the first MARS plume's tile date (a backdated start) to the catalogue end (2026-09-13), policy frozen: 1,204 episodes at 425 facilities (tier 1 94, tier 2 356, tier 3 754); 277 detections refused (below 100 kg/h or no rate) and 372 linked; rebates 2,292.00 policy units (a parameter, not a price).
card.l1Sentence: L1 is a cadence badge, not corroboration quality: 0.8% of episodes had another Carbon Mapper instrument detect within ±7 days, over the 1,122 sources MARS labels absent today — a label decided after the window.
card.l2Sentence: 11 % of episodes had a MARS plume from a satellite other than EMIT or Tanager within 7 days (132 of 1,204; over the 1,122 sources MARS labels absent today — a label decided after the window; MARS rows on the start date excluded).
card.refundsSentence: Counterfactual (no clause existed): refunds count only qualified passes (cloud flag, origin intersect without look-ahead, per-source query and no plume within 1.5 km, MARS ±7 d, 60-day publication lag). Scene data covers 174 facilities (the join candidates, which had a Tanager plume within 1.5 km in Mar–Sep 2026 and open a claim, plus two demo cases, among the 1,122 sources MARS labels absent today — a label decided after the window). Of their 628 claims, 49 had a counted pass (124 passes on 111 scenes): installments 17 released, 4 cancelled, 0 pending (14.70 / 3.00 / 0.00 policy units); 5 released claims (3.00 units) had a plume at the facility that the clause does not count as a relapse (rate hidden, or a neighbour's source). The other 576 claims were not fetched and count nothing.
card.refundsShortSentence: Counterfactual, qualified passes only, at the 174 join-candidate and demo facilities, among the 1,122 sources MARS labels absent today — a label decided after the window: 49 of 628 claims had a counted pass; 17 installments released (14.70 policy units), 4 cancelled; 5 released claims saw a plume not counted as a relapse; 576 claims not fetched.
card.stakeSentence: Stake, not abatement: at least ~0.5 Mt CH₄/yr across 428 facilities (of the 1,122 sources MARS labels absent today — a label decided after the window), the 425 with an episode plus 3 whose plumes all fell below 100 kg/h, assuming what satellites saw on their passes holds between them; passes are partly tasked toward expected plumes, which biases the seen duty cycle upward.

definition:
targets     the 1,122 MARS oil & gas sources that are notified and labelled "absent" (join criterion rule 1)
  facility    a target with the Carbon Mapper sources it owns (nearest target within 1.5 km, join rule 3); passes are
              the union of their observation dates; a detection at the facility is a Carbon Mapper plume (de-duplicated
              by plume_id) whose origin lies within 1.5 km of the target, on that date
  start       the first MARS plume's tile date (a backdated start: MARS publishes a plume after its tile date, so a
              covenant could not have been written on that day); only passes strictly after it count; end = the last
              observation date in cm_timelines.json (catalogue end)
  episode     a detection with a quantified rate >= minRateKgH (100 kg/h); tier of the largest quantified plume that
              day; a detection within 30 days (linkWindow) of the episode that anchors it is LINKED (no new rebate)
  rebate      the tier's amount in policy units (POLICY_V2_VERDICT_ONLY tier amounts; a parameter, not a price)
  claim       each episode opens one; since = episode date + 30 days; cap = the episode's rebate; the next episode
              (a relapse) cancels it, effective on the relapse's detection date. Which way each choice errs:
                - effective on the detection date, earlier than on chain (publication + the core's windows): fewer
                  refunds than the contract would release;
                - only a quantified plume >= minRateKgH from an owned source is a relapse: a plume at the facility
                  with a hidden rate, below 100 kg/h, or from a neighbour's source (join rule 3) does not cancel:
                  more refunds. `releasedWithPlumeSeen` lists those claims; the `qualified_conservative` variant
                  also treats an own source's plume with a hidden rate as a relapse (JSON only)
  clean pass  a detection-free pass after since, before the relapse, counted 61 days after the scene (60-day
              publication lag + 1-day clean window) and only if that is by the catalogue end. Variants:
                qualified    a scene of that date passes spec-v2 §2 rules 1-6 (cleanpass_rules.qualify) for THIS claim
                             on the committed scene records (data/derived/scenes_v1/, fetched for the join candidates
                             and the three demo cases that open a claim): cloud flag, origin intersect without
                             look-ahead, per-source query and plumes within 1.5 km, MARS +/- 7 days, floor <= the
                             episode rate, published; counted at max(scene + 60 d, scene publication) + 1 d. Other
                             facilities are "unqualified — scene data not fetched" and count 0
                upper_bound  every detection-free pass whose instrument has a published floor <= the episode rate and
                             no MARS plume within +/- 7 days (cloud and footprint not checked: an upper bound)
  installments  3 / 6 / 10 counted passes -> 30 / 30 / 40 % of the cap; claimable 64 days after counting; the final
              needs two instruments, no MARS plume in [since, its triggering pass] (the corroboration), and is
              claimable no earlier than since + 540 + 63 days; it must fit the covenant (since + 603 <= end + 60).
              Released when claimable before the relapse and by the catalogue end; cancelled when the relapse comes
              first; pending when claimable after the catalogue end
  corroboration badges  L1 = another Carbon Mapper instrument detects at the facility within +/- 7 days; L2 = a MARS
              plume (other satellites) within +/- 7 days
  stake band  the v1 method per facility over the passes after start (stake.band_from: duty cycle with its 95 %
              Clopper-Pearson interval x P10 / median / P90 plume rate x 8,760 h), summed over quantified facilities
              (a sum of per-source bands, not a joint interval); CO2e with GWP-100 and GWP-20 (floors.py). A stake,
              not abatement: satellites see plumes above their floor on a fraction of days
economicSentence: Context, not a comparison: the IEA writes that 'nearly all methane abatement options could be deployed at a GHG price of less than USD 20 per tonne of CO2-eq' (IEA, Global Methane Tracker 2024, Methane emissions in a 1.5 °C pathway, https://www.iea.org/reports/global-methane-tracker-2024/methane-emissions-in-a-15-0c-pathway, read 2026-10-15). The clause's tier amounts are policy units and are not converted to a currency.

label: counterfactual: if these sources had been under the clause; no clause existed; amounts in policy units, never a currency

scene_data.byCountryNote: the country mix follows the join selection: 71 of 203 join candidates are in Turkmenistan, the country with the most counted passes

concentration.note: one wide EMIT or Tanager scene can cover two facilities; each facility counts it for its own claim

publicationLag.note: claim-by-pass refusals = timeline passes the walk refused BEFORE_PUBLICATION_LAG for a claim; (facility, date) checks = scene dates whose first refusal is the 60-day lag (not yet run at the fetch time) for at least one claim

qualifiedSceneDatesOffTimeline.note: dates with a scene that qualifies for some claim but no pass in the facility's observation timeline (cm_timelines.json); the walk iterates the timeline, so they are not counted

releasedWithPlumeSeen.note: released although a CH4 plume with origin within 1.5 km was seen after since and by the last release; the clause does not count it as a relapse (only a quantified plume >= 100 kg/h from an owned source is one). See qualified_conservative for the totals when an own source's plume with a hidden rate is a relapse

scene_data.scope: join_v1 candidates + the three demo cases with >= 1 backtest claim
scene_data.source: data/derived/scenes_v1/ (pipeline/scene_records.py; raw responses in data/raw/, untracked)

selection: the 1,122 sources MARS labels absent today — a label decided after the window

stake_band.label: stake, not abatement: a sum of per-source v1 bands (not a joint interval); only the low bound is quoted
stake_band.method: per facility: duty cycle (Clopper-Pearson 95 %) x P10 / median / P90 plume rate x 8,760 h over the passes after its first MARS plume date
stake_band.midHighLabel: mid and high: sum of per-facility bounds, not a quantile; not quoted
stake_band.taskingBias: passes are partly tasked toward expected plumes, so the duty cycle seen on passes is biased upward; the low bound uses the duty cycle's 2.5 % lower limit and the P10 rate

totals.L1Label: cadence badge (another Carbon Mapper instrument within +/- 7 days, any rate), not corroboration
totals.L2Label: a MARS plume from a satellite other than EMIT or Tanager within 7 days; MARS rows on the start date excluded

qualified.label: qualified passes (cloud flag, origin intersect without look-ahead, per-source query and no plume within 1.5 km, MARS ±7 d, 60-day publication lag); counted only at facilities with committed scene data (data/derived/scenes_v1/: the join candidates and the three demo cases that open a claim); elsewhere not fetched, not counted

qualified_conservative.label: the qualified variant, plus: a CH4 plume with a hidden rate from one of the facility's own sources within 1.5 km (today's catalogue, or a detection without a rate in the plume snapshot) after since is a relapse; JSON only, not on the card

upper_bound.label: cloud and footprint unchecked; not an estimate; JSON only, never quoted

variants.qualified: spec-v2 §2 rules 1-6 (cleanpass_rules.qualify) on the committed scene records (data/derived/scenes_v1/), keyed by claim, rule 2 without look-ahead, counted at the scene's attestable time + cleanWindow; facilities outside the fetch scope are unqualified — scene data not fetched
variants.upper_bound: every detection-free pass with a floored instrument and no MARS plume (any MARS row) within +/- 7 days; cloud and footprint unchecked; not an estimate
